name: Eldorado do Sul (Brazil)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms with a mural crown, a shield divided purple, white and red with a cogwheel, over a scroll reading 08-06 ELDORADO DO SUL 1988.
history: Eldorado do Sul is a municipality in the state of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 27 May 1991 (the municipal symbols were prescribed by Municipal Law No. 188 of 27 May 1991, amended by Law No. 2,934 of 2008, according to Flags of the World).
